meta.notes: LoRA distilled from a 70B on 1,091 routed rows of grimgar06 and mushoku18, scored on four gold books it never saw. Arms share one loaded model and differ only by peft disable_adapter().

rows.line: Ranta! Don’t wander off too far!
That line you saw is something anyone who’s gained some experience will have seen once or twice—or felt, rather. That might be the more correct way to describe it.
Moguzo, take the foreman! Ranta, one of the followers is yours! Take it out as quick as you can! For the other two, Yume and I will manage them for now...!
Ngh...!
Yume!
Meow, meow, meow, meow, meow!

Nuh-uh, no way. Yume’s a hunter. And Yume loves her white god Elhit-chan, too. Yume just thinks, since she was facin’ that kobbie in solar combat, she shoulda kept it that way to the end! Also, don’t call my boobs tiny!
You say that, but Yume, she doesn’t know how to make her breasts get bigger!
You’re terrible.
Bwuh!
Y-Yume...
I-I don’t think you should do that in front of other people...
Huh? Does it work better if Yume does it when no one’s around?
No, uh... That’s not the problem...
Augh! Ranta, you dummy!
I’m no dummy! I’m the terrible king of sexual harassers! Freshly crowned! Revere me!
You got something to complain about?
Well, I do.
About you, Haruhiro,
Man, I think you’re misunderstanding something.
...the way you were moving was weird, man.
Well, it’s not really that anything’s up.
...Are you going somewhere?
—Ah... Geez.
No, it’s not that I need anything.
Let’s go, Choco.
—Heyyyyyy! Waaaaake uuuuuup!
You were sleeping the day away, so I decided to be a nice guy and gently wake you up, you know?
What could possibly be wrong with it?!

Shove off, Moguzo! You just stay quiet! This is between me and Haruhiro! Until it’s settled, neither of us can move on! This is about setting things right between us, as men! Hey, Haruhiro! Right here, right now, we’ll settle this!
How should I know?
—So,

You didn’t wake up at the usual time, and Moguzo said something stupid about waiting and letting you wake up on your own, so there I was, feeling real hungry, and so I went to the bakery. Yeah, the bakery. You know where I mean? Tattan’s Bakery, just outside of West Town. Well, when I did, there were a bunch of volunteer soldiers there. They were talking about it. Now, I’ll bet you want to ask what ‘it’ was, right? Well, hold your horses. There’s a proper order, a sequence, to all this. It’s like that in dating, too, isn’t it? Oh, maybe it’s too soon for you to understand that. You’re still just a little kid, after all. I mean, it’s pretty obvious that you’re still a virgin. Not me, of course. I’m the king of the old in and out. It’s like they say, experienced candidates receive preferential treatment. You get me? With my incredible technique, I leave those she-cats in an ecstatic frenzy.
It’s not nonsense,
The only thing that comes out of my mouth is truth. In other words, it’s all fact.
How about you try dying then? Huh?
Huh? Did you just say something?
You’re repeating yourself, Haruhiro-kuuuun,
Y-You’re not holding back...! Ow! That hurts! Sto— Are you trying to kill me?! Fine! I’ll talk! I’ll talk, okay! Okay?! It’s an order! There’s an order!
You can’t stop yourself from getting hungry. Look, we just so happen to have some bread here, so why not eat?
—Yum...! This’s the stuff! It’s so good! Soruzo’s awesome!
S-Soruzo’s delicious, huh,
...Moguzo, correct me if I’m wrong, but is that your second—No, third, bowl?
Y-Yeah. It’s easy to eat, you know, so I just keep wolfing it down faster and faster...
Huh...? Ah, yeah, uh... I’m not so sure...? The soup might be a bit hard...
...I’m amazed you said you could make it, then,
...Yeah. If you add garlic, and maybe ginger... It might give it a more satisfying flavor.
Moguzo, buddy, we could do it, don’t you think? Once we make some money, what say you and me open a restaurant?!
Ah, hahaha... But, we’re volunteer soldiers and all...
Buddy, don’t sweat the small stuff like that!
You just said the same thing again,

Shut up, Haruhiro. Just shut up. Seriously. Seriously. You can get lost! I’m having an important talk with Moguzo here! Anyway, how about it, Moguzo? Want to do that with me? Ranta and Moguzo’s Soruzo Shop. We’ll split the profits seventy to me, thirty to you... is what I’d like to say, but I’m fine with splitting it fifty-fifty. We’ll start studying now, so we’ll be ready when the time comes. How about it? Hm?
It could be nice. Doing something like that. Compared to fighting... Well, it seems easier at least. I’ll think about it.
—So! Finally, I think it’s time for me to talk about the order! Are you mentally prepared? Am I good to start? I am, right? Don’t you tell me otherwise at this late stage of the game.
You’re being seriously annoying, so just tell us already...
Haaaaruhiroooo! When you call people annoying, you’re being one hundred! Nay! One thousand, ten thousand, no, no, no, five hundred million times as annoying! Get that through your head already!
You only need to say ‘yeah’ one hundred times,
Yeah—Wait, not one time, one hundred times?! That’s too many!
Don’t underestimate me! Brilliantly surprising people is what I, Ranta-sama, do!
...Even Moguzo’s laughing,
Haaaaruhiiiiro-kuuuun...
...What’s with that way of saying my name? It’s kind of creepy.
That’s your fault!
It’s a two-headed snake!
One gold coin...
Consolation money. Take it.
Won’t any spot do?

Riverside Iron Fortress. This fortress, it’s about 40 km west of Deadhead, on the bank of a jet river, and if you go further upstream, you’ll run into the territory of the former Kingdom of Nananka. You know what that is? No, I bet you don’t. The former Kingdom of Nananka. It means orcs, man, orcs. Nowadays, there’s a country full of orcs there. So, they’re able to travel by boat and carry in supplies and troops. Deadhead’s a teeny-tiny little keep, but when the Frontier Army attacks, they raise smoke signals, or something. When they do that, reinforcements get sent in from Riverside immediately.
But it’s a full 40 km away.
The orcish army’s got what they call dragoons,
They’re called dragoons, but they don’t ride dragons, they ride these huge lizards,
Clever thinking, just what I’d expect from my business partner.
So, moving on... Where were we?
Riverside Iron Fortress, was it?
The Frontier Army’s learned from their mistakes, wahahaha,
...Isn’t it kinda dangerous?
And, hold on, we’re not attacking with just volunteer soldiers... there’s no way that’d be it, right?
Obviously, the Frontier Army will accompany us, or rather, they’re the main force and we’ll be accompanying them,
The volunteer soldiers are there in a supporting role, of course. Try to think a little. Are you a moron? Don’t just keep looking at it with sleepy eyes like that, Haruhirion.
Don’t talk about my eyes. I’ll stab you from behind. Also, drop the Haruhirion thing.

Let’s see, at Deadhead there’ll be five hundred or six hundred from the Frontier Army, they were saying. As for volunteer soldiers, it was one hundred, maybe a hundred and fifty. Riverside’s one tough fortress, so I expect it’ll turn into a pretty intense battle. I hear Soma’s Day Breakers, ‘Red Devil’ Ducky’s Berserkers, ‘One-on-One’ Max’s Iron Knuckle, and Shinohara’s Orion will be participating there. Honestly, that’s some crazy stuff. ‘If you aren’t confident in your skills,’ it feels like they’re saying, ‘if you come, you’re gonna die, so don’t come, you’ll only get in the way.’

One gold coin! We’ve gotta do it, with that up for grabs! It’s decided! Yup! Let’s go and apply already! There’re three days left before the deadline, but you know that proverb about striking while the iron’s hot, right? Or was it an idiom? Well, whichever, it’s a thing they say, and I say I’ll go to the office right now and—
Well, I’ll bring it up with them tonight, and we can make a decision after that. There’s still time, so it should be fine.
Oh, fine, if you insist.
Of course, I’m getting beer, like a real man should,
I’ll get mead,
Ah, me, too,
Good work, everyone,
—Bwahh! I... win...!
I know, right? I am awesome, aren’t I? You really do get it, Moguzo,
No, a business partner...
What’s wrong, Shihoru?
Shihoru. I’ll bet you were imagining something weird.
So, that means I don’t have the same delusion energy coursing through me that you do, get it?
Yume has her own opinion, too!
Ranta, you did!
Yume knows that much!
Yeah, well, before we talk about what you do or don’t know, stop getting words wrong so often! Do you have holes for ears?!
Yep, they’re there. Holes in my ears. Everyone has holes for ears. Or are you blind? Do you have holes for eyes?

—Here we go again. This is it. This here. This is the problem with our party’s leader. He likes to pick at any little mistake people make! On top of that, the way he criticizes them for it is downright malicious! What an awful personality!
If you don’t want to hear it, then don’t act in a way that makes me say it, huh? Show some restraint, okay?
A business?
Ohhh.
Ramen—Wait...
Ramen is... Um... Huh? That’s odd. Yume, did she know it... from somewhere? Maybe? What was it again? Huh? What was Yume talking about with everyone again?
About ramen,

We were talking about ramen. We... We probably know what ramen is. That’s right. Soruzo, it’s kind of like ramen. When I first ate it, I thought it tasted like something. It was ramen I was thinking of. I couldn’t remember it at the time. I wonder why not. I’ve always loved ramen. Ranta-kun.
Huh? Oh...?
But, me, I don’t want to open a soruzo place, I want to make ramen. I’ll save up money, study, and when I can make ramen that tastes just right, let’s do it, let’s open that restaurant.
Yeah! You’ll be in charge of the cooking and raising capital! Leave everything else to me! I swear I’ll lead us to success!
...The cooking is fine, but raising capital, too...?
...Hrmm...
...Oh. Is that right?
Majority vote.
Well...
—It’s kind of like...
No, no...
Augh...
W-Well... You know. What is it...? Well... Um, nothing... Really.
Bye.
Er... Ba...sically, yeah... Uh... Hm...
No way?!
What are you doing here?
Somehow, what?
I won’t say.
...Yeah. I don’t remember.
Neither do I. Not even my family or friends. I don’t remember them at all.
So, on that note,
could it be... Like, for me, I joined a party, and I think I met them all for the first time here, but maybe that’s not the case, right?
Ah... Yeah, that’s right, isn’t it?
...Hmm. Well, can I call you Hiro?
Sure.
I’m okay with that,
Better hit the hay. ...What are you up to, Choco? It’s pretty late.
Can’t sleep?
Choco, you’re a thief?
Ah. You look like one,
Huh? What part of me?
You’re lanky.
No, that may be true, but... I’m a thief because I’m lanky? Is that the image you have? Is that what thieves are like to you? Why did you become a thief?
Going with the flow?
Yeah. Since we’re both thieves, and all.
It’s something someone else gave me, anyway,
The same time?
Old Cat.
That’s some coincidence,
Who’s Barbara?
I should never have become a thief,
I’d say so.
I want to take it easy,
Do you find it all a pain?
Hiro, is your party accepting the order, too?
I don’t want to do it, though. It seems kind of dangerous.
But, apparently, we are.
Okay, we’ll put it to a vote, then.
The subject is whether or not we participate in the order for Operation ‘Two-Headed Snake.’ All in favor, raise your hands.
Huhh?! I did not! Like I’d do that! No, wait, maybe I did. Yeah, I did. So, what then, it’s four? Four. That’s a majority, huh.
What are you, a magnifying glass?
Magnifying glasses don’t speak.
No, it doesn’t quite mean that,
I’d like to know...
He’s garbage at it, though!
Haruhiro-kun is trying his hardest for us!
...I think so, too,
Agreed,
Ganging up on me?! Well, I don’t care, it doesn’t matter to me one bit! Bring it on!

The fact that we’ll be getting one gold between the advance payment and the rest of the payment is a big deal. If it’s not wrapped up in a day, from the second day on we’ll be given a stipend of 30 silver a day. Also, there may be special compensation awarded in the field, too, right, Ranta?
You know, for this order, we get paid just for participating in it, right?
Call me whatever you want. I don’t care in the slightest.
Haruhiro, you weakling!
That’s got nothing to do with this!
...Y-Yume, he means...
Heh, heh, heh, heh, heh, heh...
Awful personalityyyyyy? Huhhhhhhhhh? What are you talking abouuuuuuut? I just tell it like it is, you knoooooooow?
say what you will about us, we’re the party that took down Death Spots. And the keep this time is called Deadhead. The names are close. I dunno, don’t you think it’s a sign? It could be.
How about you, Merry?
If that’s what everyone’s decided, I’m okay with it. I’ll just do everything I can to keep you all alive.
Let’s go with that.
—This is impossible!
You can’t just suddenly expect us to fall asleep at this time of day...
I can never get enough sleep, but I’m not tired yet...
If we can’t sleep anyway, you wanna go?!
There’s only one thing.
The one thing is... that one thing!
...What starts with ‘boo’?
You’re the one who started this. Are you just making it up as you go along? If you haven’t thought of something, why not just say so?
M-Me?
Boo...? Bo... Boo... Boooo....
Keep it up, Moguzo! It’s coming out! You’re almost there! Go on!
I’ll squeeze them! I’ll squeeze them like crazy!
...That’s practically rape, man.
No, that’s not okay to do, as a person...
Well, yeah,

Even if I forced them to let me squeeze them, it’d be pointless, wouldn’t it? What then? I want a ‘You can squeeze them.’ Or rather, a ‘Please, squeeze them.’ It’s gotta be something like that. You’ve gotta have love.

Bullseye, huh? Merry’s got the best looks, no question there, but she’s clearly out of your league. Shihoru’s got huge boobs, which is a big point in her favor. Her face is decently cute, too. But that personality of hers seems like a pain, and she doesn’t talk to guys much, anyway. An indecisive guy with low self-esteem like you is gonna go for an airhead like Yume. That’s just how it is.
I’m pretty sure girls aren’t into you, either, for an entirely different reason.
If there are men and there are women, there’s no way you don’t have someone! Our male instincts naturally select a female.
It’s more like... I admire her, you could say,
Or I sometimes think... ‘She’s so pretty...’
...You only ever say things you shouldn’t.
You don’t dig wax out of your eyes, that’d go terribly, and how many times do I have to tell you not to talk about my eyes?
Still, though,
Moguzo wants Merry, huh. Nice choice. Yep, that’s my partner for you.
Ha... hahaha... Um, but, I just think she’s pretty, that’s all...
The truth is, after that... I don’t know, but just a little... I’ve been more... conscious?... of her...
Moguzo, you dog, you! Push, push, and push harder! Who knows, maybe it’ll even work out for you?!
Just confess, okay?!
Don’t you want him to find happiness?!
Yeah, that figures,
It’d be awkward for me if you did, anyway. I was just saying it! I’m first-rate at just saying stuff!
Ranta, you’re totally third-rate,
You asked me and Moguzo, but you haven’t said anything for yourself.
Huhh? Meeee? You want meeee to? What, guys, do you reeeeally want to know?
You’re hopeless, you know that. Well, if you insist...
I’m not goooonna tell you, moooorons.
Man, don’t screw with us...!
Y-You’re awful, Ranta-kun!
Gwaaaahahahahahahaha! Don’t think you’ll get a secret out of me so easily! I got your secrets perfectly, though!
You! Can’t! Do! It!
I swear, I’ll make you talk!
...Hahh. Hahh. Hahh...
What’s up?
Feeling tense?
Huh? Ah, y-yeah... J-Just a little. No, a lot...
I think she means he doesn’t sweat the small stuff, and tries to be magnanimous, maybe...
Ouyou...?
This’s it, y’know,
Hrm. Yume’s not sure herself, but it’s kinda like this?
...Um, Yume,
Ho? Sure. Guess so. Ah, Haru-kun, Haru-kun!
Huh? What?
Moguzo-kun.
Hoooooooo. Hahhhhhhhhh... Ah! Th-That calmed me down a bit... maybe.
Normally, breathing is something you do unconsciously,
I think that’s got to put a lot of pressure on you, doesn’t it?
If anyone’s leveled up to the max, it’s me, duh! If I’ve leveled up 30 times, Moguzo’s leveled up, like, 25, maybe!
That’s awfully humble, coming from you,
Meat shield...
I’m counting on you, partner! No, meat shield!
I-I think I’d prefer to be called partner...
Hm? You would?

The area outside of Deadhead Watching Keep is as I was just saying. To quickly review, camps centered around towers are dotted around the area near the fortress. In each of these camps there are two to five orcs. Well, I think most of you here would know, but since a handful of you look like you don’t, I’ll say this just to be sure. These camps and the keep itself are collectively called Deadhead Watching Keep. Everyone follow me so far? Any questions? No? None, right? It would be a problem for me if there were. Anyway, next I’ll talk about the keep itself.
Next, for an outline of the operation.
Yes. It’s not bad.
Your party is with me. Disappointed, aren’t you, Kajiko?
Who’s disappointed?
Are you looking to get killed, Britney?
Oh, my.

It’s old, so it’s expensive, you know? I have my doubts about its accuracy, though. Anyway, if you have a watch, the timing should be fine. I’ll tell you what the starting time is later. Now then, how the operation will progress. Once the operation begins, we take whatever camps we come across as we advance towards the walls. Crush any camp that has orcs in it. If we dawdle, the orcs may come out of their camps to surround us, so crush them as fast as you can manage. That is the first stage.
Why do we have to do it? We already have to carry shields! Like we can carry big, heavy ladders on top of that!
I am the commander here. You don’t like it? Leave. After returning your advance, of course, okay?
...Already spent it all.
...Not ‘might.’
Shut up!
What are you, a squid, then?!
...Fine. Whatever.
Wahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha! I won! Victory is mine!
Oh, but, Bri-chan, sorry. Yume, she might’ve gone and done that thing. She may’ve detailed the conversation.
You have to derail it. Well, no, you don’t have to do that, okay?
Zip.

Okay. Now, back to the smoke signals. When Deadhead Watching Keep is under a large scale attack, they use smoke signals to alert Riverside Iron Fortress. I’m sure the signal will go up right away this time, too. But, the attack will be starting over there at the same time. Even if they call for them, reinforcements won’t come. That’s why you shouldn’t panic even if you do see a signal go up. Well, that’s about it, I suppose. I know I’ve talked a lot, but as long as we don’t make some incredible blunder, we should be able to win this. The keeper, and the bounty on any famous sorcerers, will likely have nothing to do with our detached force. Either way, it’s not going to be a difficult battle. You kids without much experience can put your minds at ease, too.
Achoo!
Begin the attack!
Charge! Destroy the camps!
Waaaay off in the distance, there’s smoke goin’ up, too!
We have to help them! Let’s take on the orcs ourselves! We’ll set down our ladders and shields for now!
Sure thing!
It’s finally time! To graduate! I’m losing my virginity!
Umph!
Conserve your magic for now!
Once you get used to it, you can fight them!
We aren’t used to how orcs move yet, that’s all! Moguzo, you can do it! There’s no way you can’t!
Since when?!
Hey, hey, hey!
Heh, heh, heh...
I got my vice! Finally, I graduated from being a virgin! Congratulations, me!
Like I should know!
Shut up! Just shut up! Just because you’re a little tall doesn’t mean...!
Ranta! Enough!
—We’ve go to go! We’re the ladder team!
We’ve got to assemble them first!
—Oh! That’s right!
Merry, Yume, Shihoru, use the shields!
Hunnnnnnnnnngh...!
It’s fine! We’ve got shields!
Move...!
Hold on, Renji!
From the main gate?!
No butts, no farting around, none of your crap! We’re going!
Okay, let’s go! Moguzo and I will take the lead! Everyone else, follow after us!
It’s dangerous to stay here!
Hurry! It’ll probably be safer once we get down off the wall!
I know that, you dolt!
...Huh? Why don’t you have shields?
Urkh... Even Merry did it...
You’re doing fabulous! If we keep on pushing, eventually our allies will come!
...No, it’s not!
This is bad!
Anyone with hands to spare, go defend against the enemies on the other side!
We’ll do it, too!
Gashwarl!
Gahaha! Moguzo’s already taken down two of them, huh! That’s my partner for you!
What’s your relationship with the girl...?
Why’re you acting like you can afford to ask questions right now?!
I’m acting like I can afford to because I can, duh! Whoa...?!
Shut up, moron! Take that! Reject...!
It’s no good! It doesn’t look like they’ve broken it! I can’t see from here, but it looks like they’re fighting a hard battle!
I’m going to the front gate!
Britney, by the time you get back, it’s all going to be over...!
You go tell the worthless regular army that I’m going to take that bounty!
Honestly...! Don’t be reckless, now!
I doubt we can compete with Kajiko or Renji and win, so should we go for the northeast tower like the others...?
Yume and everyone wouldn’t be able to take their heads anyway, y’know.
Yeah. Well, sorta. I guess you’re right. All right! Plundering it is, then!
Hahaha...
For a Dread Knight, those words are the highest of compliments! Mwahahaha! O Darkness, O Lord of Vice, Demon Call!
...Kehe... Kehehehehe... Kehehehe... Kehehehehehehehe... Kehe... Ranta dies.
Not ‘die, Ranta,’ but ‘Ranta dies’?! You’re suddenly predicting my death, Zodiac-kun?!
...Ehehe... Kill Ranta.
...Die... Ugly...
Zodiac-kun’s such a good boy. But, y’know, callin’ people ugly is mean...
...Kehehe... Sorry...
You may not appreciate the advice, but you guys shouldn’t push yourselves!
Oh, shove it! Zodiac-kun’s mine, so I can do whatever I want with him!
...Wh... Who’re you saying is yours...? I’m not yours... Are you stupid...? Die...
...Eehehehe... If you’ll die... I... I-I-I couldn’t be happier... Ehehehehehe...
You’re the damn fool! Let’s go!
Hunghh...!
We didn’t need your help.
Now we’re even,
You. I could use you.
it seems the prize isn’t here. Should you be taking it easy now, Renji?
Sto—
Well, Kawabe-kun is a good guy, after all.
Well, yeah, of course I love her,
Is there nothing you really, really like?
Yeah, that’s it,
Yeah, even I can totally see why.
My throat hurts.
But, you know, drinking it too often is probably bad for my health,
Could be. Athletes aren’t supposed to drink it, I hear. Soda.
Oh, I see,
Not that I’m athletic at all.
I can’t be considerate, and I can’t look out for other people, so maybe I like people who can do that.
Maybe I don’t.
Really? Huh? Am I managing to be considerate?
Hmm. Well, we’ve known each other a long time, after all.
If I did, I’d tell you.
Yeah. I said something.
But tell me.
Well, there’s a time and place for everything,
Hwahhhhh...!
Damn you and your petty tricks!
...Guh, nghhhhhhh....
Is it psychokinesis?!
Nyeh!
Leave this to me!
—Nwah!
Ah! Ah...! Ah! Ah...!
Yume, look after Merry!
What happened to Zodiac-kun?!
Myeek!
To the watchtower we were in before!
Thanks, Moguzo,
Uh... but what are comrades for?
...I’ll go scope things out,
That guy!
Star Piercer, meow!
We’ve taken out two sorcerers!
Merry! Use your magic on Renji!
Heal won’t work if he’s moving! It targets an area!
It targets an area...
No! Come get healed!
—O Light, may Lumiaris’ divine protection be upon you... cure!
No! Don’t try to handle things all by yourself!
Gashgrasha!
Ubogeh?!
Oh, also, a vice, too!
Moguzo! Renji!
We’re doing this, Ranta!
It’s 150 gold!
That’s your response?!
Hey, loser!
Exhaust!
150 gold!
Ranta! Don’t wander off too far!
That line you saw is something anyone who’s gained some experience will have seen once or twice—or felt, rather. That might be the more correct way to describe it.
Moguzo, take the foreman! Ranta, one of the followers is yours! Take it out as quick as you can! For the other two, Yume and I will manage them for now...!
Ngh...!
Yume!
Meow, meow, meow, meow, meow!

Nuh-uh, no way. Yume’s a hunter. And Yume loves her white god Elhit-chan, too. Yume just thinks, since she was facin’ that kobbie in solar combat, she shoulda kept it that way to the end! Also, don’t call my boobs tiny!
You say that, but Yume, she doesn’t know how to make her breasts get bigger!
You’re terrible.
Bwuh!
Y-Yume...
I-I don’t think you should do that in front of other people...
Huh? Does it work better if Yume does it when no one’s around?
No, uh... That’s not the problem...
Augh! Ranta, you dummy!
I’m no dummy! I’m the terrible king of sexual harassers! Freshly crowned! Revere me!
You got something to complain about?
Well, I do.
About you, Haruhiro,
Man, I think you’re misunderstanding something.
...the way you were moving was weird, man.
Well, it’s not really that anything’s up.
...Are you going somewhere?
—Ah... Geez.
No, it’s not that I need anything.
Let’s go, Choco.
—Heyyyyyy! Waaaaake uuuuuup!
